lines.text: Hi, my furnace stopped working. Can someone come out tomorrow?
I'm sorry to hear that. I'm Donna, the AI assistant for this business. I can book a visit. Is morning or afternoon better?
I have 9:30 or 11:00 tomorrow morning. Which works?
Booked for 9:30 tomorrow. You'll get a text confirmation now, and the technician will call before arriving.

faq.q: Will callers know they are talking to an AI?
faq.a: Yes. Donna.AI introduces itself as an AI assistant for your business.

faq.q: What happens with calls it cannot handle?
faq.a: It takes a message and passes the caller to you, by text or email, with a summary.

faq.q: Do I need new phone hardware?
faq.a: No. Your calls are forwarded to Donna.AI when you choose, for example after hours or when you are busy.

faq.q: What does the founding offer include?
faq.a: $497 for your first month, with the setup fee waived. After the first month the package price applies.
Yes. Book a demo and you can hear it on our demo line.
